title: Tag every keepAlive:true provider in features/profiles with the grep-able // keepAlive: justification SM-6 requires
why: SM-6 requires every `keepAlive: true` to carry an inline `// keepAlive:` comment so a checker can grep for compliance. All 8 keepAlive providers in this batch (active_profile_provider.dart:17, parent_pin_session_provider.dart:9, pin_flow_controller.dart:130, profile_providers.dart:21/28/36/77/161) instead use prose `///` doc comments that don't match the required grep pattern — the same pattern holds nearly everywhere else in the codebase (only sync_orchestrator_providers.dart uses the literal tag), so a Rule-0 checker for SM-6 could not be written against the current codebase without a mass rename.
recommendation: Add a literal `// keepAlive: <reason>` line next to each @Riverpod(keepAlive: true) in this batch (can keep the existing prose doc comment alongside it).
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 8 listed keepAlive providers has an inline `// keepAlive:` comment a grep-based checker can match

corrections: 2 of the 8 sites (active_profile_provider.dart:17, pin_flow_controller.dart:130) do carry some keepAlive-specific prose justification, just not the grep-matchable `//` tag format — slightly weaker than the finding's 'all 8 use unrelated prose' framing, but doesn't change the verdict since none would pass a literal Rule-0 grep.
